business: Trullàs Divergence 24/7 Scanner (US equities & options swing scanner)
target: Self-directed retail and semi-pro swing traders, 24 to 58, who trade US stocks or options 2 to 10 times a month with $10k to $250k accounts
where: Online web app (English; US, UK, Canada, EU retail traders trading NYSE/Nasdaq)

behaviours.name: TradingView / Finviz loyalist
behaviours.how: Already pays for TradingView or uses free Finviz daily and hates duplicating subscriptions.

behaviours.name: Evidence skeptic
behaviours.how: Refuses any scanner without multi-year, net-of-slippage proof that signals beat random entries.

behaviours.name: Time-strapped prep trader
behaviours.how: Checks setups for 20 minutes before the New York open or at night around a day job.

behaviours.name: Cost-cutter / DIY tinkerer
behaviours.how: Uses thinkorswim Stock Hacker, Pine scripts, or Python yfinance instead of paying $50/mo.

behaviours.name: Tools hopper
behaviours.how: Tries new scanners and journals via trials, cancels fast if workflow feels cluttered.

behaviours.name: Review & community checker
behaviours.how: Searches Reddit r/swingtrading and Trustpilot before entering a card, wary of auto-renew traps.
